test_Registry_basic_registration: test the Registry class by registering functions via decorator and method call then retrieving them by name
test_Registry_dunder_methods: test the Registry dunder methods including __contains__, __len__, __iter__, __getitem__, __str__, and __repr__
test_LazyRegisterable_with_name: test lazy registration by creating a LazyRegisterable with a module and name then resolving it via Registry.get
test_LazyRegisterable_without_name: test lazy registration without an object name by using LazyRegisterable with only a module and resolving via register_dict
test_Registry_get_names: test the Registry get_names method to list all registered object names and verify registration count
